newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: PacDun plans A$100 mln purchase - paper.
newsitem.headline: PacDun plans A$100 mln purchase - paper.

text.p: Australian industrial group Pacific Dunlop Ltd will announce on Monday that its protective products division plans to buy a U.S. company in a deal worth A$100 million, the Sydney Morning Herald reported on Friday.
The newspaper said the purchase would be made by PacDun's Ansell division, which makes surgical latex gloves and condoms.
"The target is believed to be based in the eastern United States, possibly North Carolina," the newspaper said.
Company officials declined to comment to the newspaper and were unavailable on Friday.
The newspaper identified Lakeland Industries Inc of New York and the industrial products division of Baxter International Inc as possible targets.
Pacific Dunlop shares closed two cents higher at A$3.44 on Thursday. The market was closed on Friday for the Anzac Day national holiday.
